irVersion.description: IR shape version; gated by ir_validate.migrate() on from-ir. Absent = current.

accent.description: Course accent hex; null = use the active brand's default accent

graded.description: scored course: KCs count toward a score; status becomes passed/failed (default false = completion-only, unscored)

passingScore.description: graded only: percent correct required to pass (default 80)

retry.description: max attempts per knowledge check before it locks + reveals (0 = one-shot). Graded courses score the final answer within the attempts.

gateCompletion.description: M13: when true (default for graded courses) a FAILING score blocks completion (a retry is offered); false = the course completes regardless of score (score is still reported). A build may override via --no-gate.

objectives.description: M13: graded sections rolled up as scored objectives (per-section subscores reported to the LMS as cmi.objectives / cmi5 result.extensions). Each = {id, name, pass?}.

preset.description: C19: course PURPOSE preset (compliance/onboarding/product-skill/refresher/standard) declared via `*Preset:*` — sets the audience reading-level band the build report flags against

xp.description: gamification #3: points/XP MOTIVATIONAL overlay declared via `*Points:* on` (purely cosmetic — never affects the graded score, completion gate, or LMS score). Absent = no overlay.

weights.description: points per scorable block by category

tiers.description: level tiers as [name, threshold] where threshold is a 0..1 fraction of earnable XP

celebrate.description: gamification #6: confetti CELEBRATION overlay declared via `*Celebrate:* on` (purely cosmetic — never affects the score, completion gate, or LMS record). A zero-dep canvas burst fires on the enabled moments, honoring prefers-reduced-motion. Absent = no overlay.

pass.description: fire on crossing the graded pass mark

level.description: fire on an XP tier level-up

gated.description: Hidden until the preceding continue gate is clicked

src.description: assets/<file> path (bundled) or an https URL (embed/streamed)

mode.description: video: 'file' = self-hosted <video> bundled in the zip; 'embed' = streamed <iframe>

requireComplete.description: video(file)/audio only: gate course completion on the media 'ended' event. Ignored for embed (cross-origin, unobservable).

intro.description: objectives: optional lead-in line (default 'After this lesson, you will be able to:')

id.description: knowledgeCheck: stable id, reported as the cmi.interactions id in graded courses

objective.description: knowledgeCheck/matching/sequence/fillBlank (M13): id of the graded section (objective) this block scores into (M12 blocks contribute fractional got/max credit)

draw.description: questionBank (C5): how many questions to draw from the pool at runtime (absent/>=pool → draw all)

questions.description: questionBank (C5): the pool of question blocks (knowledgeCheck/matching/sequence/fillBlank); the player draws `draw` of them per attempt

name.description: sectionStart (M13): graded objective label; KCs sharing a name roll up into one subscore

graded.description: sectionStart (M13): this section is a scored objective (declared a name, pass, or quiz/graded marker)

pass.description: sectionStart (M13): section pass threshold (percent) for this objective

arrow.description: button: append the animated arrow icon

action.description: button: 'link' opens href in a new tab; 'modal' opens the bundled modal payload

requireOpen.description: cardGrid: learner must open every modal card before the course can complete (like required media)

columns.description: cardGrid: preferred column count (the grid still reflows to 1 on narrow screens)

cards.description: cardGrid: the content cards. A card with a 'modal' expands on click; with only 'link' it is a clickable callout; with neither it is static.

icon.description: Optional leading glyph or inline <svg> shown above the title

teaser.description: Short summary line shown on the card face

href.description: Clickable-callout target (used when there is no modal)

entries.description: accordion/process/flashcard rows. accordion/process: {title, html, src?, kind?}. flashcard: {frontHtml, frontSrc?, backHtml, backSrc?}.

src.description: optional entry image; null/absent means no image

zones.description: dragDrop: the drop targets. `x`/`y` (percent 0-100) position a zone over the optional background diagram (`src`); absent → zones render as a labeled row.

pool.description: categorize/dragDrop: the items to place; each carries its correct bucket/zone id in 'target'

grid.description: wordSearch: the finished square letter grid (rows of single-character strings). crossword: a rectangular grid where a blocked cell is null. Generated at build time from `words`.

words.description: wordSearch/crossword: the target words with their placement (r/c = start cell; wordSearch dr/dc = step direction; crossword dir = across|down + num = clue number) and an optional clue.

slices.description: gameShow: one multiple-choice question per wheel slice. Options are shuffled at build time (src/gameshow.py) so `answer` (the correct option index) is fixed and resume-stable.

board.description: quizBoard: one column per category; each holds ordered tiles (top row lowest value). Each tile is an MCQ whose options are shuffled at build time (src/quizboard.py, reusing src/gameshow.py) so `answer` is fixed and resume-stable, plus an escalating point `value`.

rounds.description: speedStreak: an ordered run of multiple-choice questions answered one at a time. Options are shuffled at build time (src/speedstreak.py, reusing src/gameshow.py) so `answer` (the correct option index) is fixed and resume-stable.

timer.description: speedStreak: optional per-question countdown in whole seconds (0/absent = untimed). Cosmetic only — drives a speed bonus, never correctness or the graded score.

pairs.description: matching (M12): each pair = a left item and its correct right partner (id is stable); the learner matches lefts to rights, scored with partial credit

steps.description: sequence (M12): the steps in their CORRECT order (array order = answer); the learner assigns each a position, scored with partial credit

blanks.description: fillBlank (M12): each = text around a blank (`before`/`after`, the input goes between) + an accept-list of `answers` (lenient match: trim/collapse-space/case-insensitive)

feedbackIncorrect.description: categorize/knowledgeCheck: feedback shown on a wrong answer

scenes.description: scenario (linear fallback): each scene = narrative + response options with feedback

model.description: reflection: a model/example answer (HTML) revealed after the learner submits, for self-assessment. Authored at build time — there is no runtime AI scorer (SCORM runs offline).

criteria.description: reflection: optional rubric points a good answer includes, revealed alongside the model answer for self-assessment

accent.description: timeline/comparison: brand accent role for the block (per-milestone/panel accents are set on each item; omit to auto-cycle)

milestones.description: timeline: ordered roadmap milestones rendered along a vertical brand axis (HTML player parity with the 'timeline' slide layout)

accent.description: brand accent role for this milestone; omit to auto-cycle

panels.description: comparison: 2-3 side-by-side panels for old-vs-new or option A/B/C (HTML player parity with the 'comparison' slide layout)

sublabel.description: small label under the panel heading

accent.description: brand accent role for this panel; omit to auto-cycle

callout.description: highlighted callout box at the foot of the panel

chart.description: chart block: visualization type. bar=column comparison; line=trend; area=filled trend; pie/donut=part-to-whole; stackedBar/groupedBar=multi-series columns; horizontalBar/horizontalStackedBar=horizontal bars (good for long category names)

categories.description: chart: x-axis category labels (bar/line/stacked/grouped) or slice labels (pie). One entry per data point per series.

series.description: chart: one or more data series. pie uses exactly one series. Each series' data length must equal categories length.

data.description: numeric values aligned to categories; null = missing/no-bar

source.description: chart: REQUIRED provenance — which source document/table these figures came from. Charts with no source are invalid (no-invented-metrics guardrail).

takeaway.description: chart: OPTIONAL one-line plain-language insight (the 'so what') drawn from the plotted numbers; rendered with the chart.

infographic.description: infographic block: a poster-style overview rendered as a flowing HTML section. The content object is IDENTICAL to the 'infographic' slide-layout content schema, so one JSON serves both the slide generator and the course block.

items.description: bullets; each is either a string or a [bold, detail] pair

label.description: section label — a string or an array of label parts

modal.description: Bounded modal payload: a heading, ONE media slot, rich text, and an optional link.

mode.description: video only: 'file' self-hosted vs 'embed' streamed iframe
